dataset_summary.source_confounds: OpenStax is editorial textbook content with MathML-to-LaTeX serialization and image descriptions, not an independent CC sample. FineMath uses upstream classifier filtering and a separate extraction pipeline; fixed shards are not a uniform sample of all FineMath. Background is unlabeled.

quality_audit.manual_review_scope: FineMath: beginning/middle/end excerpts of all 50 fixed sampled documents; OpenStax: excerpts of the first 12 fixed random audit modules, plus automated complete-MathML conversion/coverage checks on every module. Not full mathematical correctness verification.
observations: OpenStax definitions, worked examples, exercises and glossary formulas are present after structured conversion; all 36534 retained MathML wrappers converted; 4 source modules with empty MathML quarantined before scoring.

OpenStax includes 2625 figures with textual descriptions. Images themselves are not encoded; a text-only view can remain insufficient for graphical exercises. Some source learning-objective text is imperfect.

FineMath sample includes genuine explanations, formula-preserving worked examples, programming/physics content, course listings, SEO/promotional pages, and malformed/inaccurate solutions. FineMath-4+ is not an adjudicated clean-math label.
The official 4plus configuration uses integer quality scores; floating-point scores can be below 4. No additional quality/topic threshold was applied locally.
No manually reviewed row was replaced or dropped based on these observations.
